---
title: "Our Mission"
---

SASA will:

- Produce up-to-date publications of high quality, which include the South African Statistical Journal (SASJ) and the Conference Proceedings.
- Send members news and information through the SASA Newsletter.
- Organise an annual conference.
- Give members access to the SASJ, the official journal, and other publications.
- Do all other work that helps these goals in a careful and organised way.
